name: What are some popular modern bathroom layout trends?

mainEntity.name: What are some popular modern bathroom layout trends?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popular modern bathroom layout trends often feature open-concept showers with frameless glass enclosures, freestanding tubs as a focal point, and smart storage solutions to maximize space and minimize clutter. Floating vanities create a sense of spaciousness, while integrated LED lighting enhances both function and ambiance. We also see a preference for distinct 'zones' within larger bathrooms for separate commode, shower, and vanity areas. These trends prioritize both luxurious aesthetics and practical, efficient use of space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Modern trends include open showers, freestanding tubs, smart storage, floating vanities, integrated lighting, and distinct functional zones.
